title: Mongo: backup restore round-trip (mongorestore ns-remap)
description: Runs `nexus backup restore mongo <id>`: locates the node holding the archive and mongorestores nexus_smoke.* into a nexus_restore_verify.* namespace (non-destructive round-trip), counting the restored docs.

observe.what: items restored >= 1 (the rs_init_test doc), restored into nexus_restore_verify via --nsInclude + --nsFrom/--nsTo

whatProves: MongoAdapter.BackupRestoreAsync round-trips the archive: discover archive node -> mongorestore with --nsInclude ns-remap -> count restored docs. Replace the id with one from `backup take`.
